en: A vintage, colorized postcard image of a broad avenue lined with grand stone buildings and mature trees. The street is lively with pedestrians dressed in early 20th-century attire, and a yellow streetcar/tram is seen traveling down the rails in the center of the street. A prominently ornate building with columns and floral decorations stands to the left. The caption at the top reads 'Zagreb. Kukovićeva ulica.'
